strategy: Every generated project contains its own reviewed .asy symbols beside the .asc schematic.
notes: Project-local symbols avoid hidden dependence on an installed LTspice library version.
Pin coordinates and electrical Prefix values are native LTspice grid facts and are independently parsed from the emitted .asy files.
A profile may retain a familiar display/reference prefix while its project-local ASY uses Prefix X for a validated three-pin subcircuit wrapper.
